mapper.sql: code_no AS id, NULLIF(p_code_no, 0) AS parent_id, code_group AS code, code_nm AS name, code_val AS value, code_dc AS description, code_depth AS depth, sort_order, CASE WHEN use_yn = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS enabled, NULL::BIGINT AS created_by, NULL::BIGINT AS updated_by, frst_reg_dt AS created_at, lst_chg_dt AS updated_at

menu_no AS id, NULLIF(p_menu_no, 0) AS parent_id, CONCAT('menu.', menu_no) AS menu_key, menu_nm AS title, menu_url AS url, menu_depth AS depth, sort_order, CASE WHEN use_yn = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS enabled, CASE WHEN open_yn = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS visible, NULL::BIGINT AS created_by, NULL::BIGINT AS updated_by, frst_reg_dt AS created_at, lst_chg_dt AS updated_at

tb_menu.menu_no AS id, NULLIF(tb_menu.p_menu_no, 0) AS parent_id, CONCAT('menu.', tb_menu.menu_no) AS menu_key, tb_menu.menu_nm AS title, tb_menu.menu_url AS url, tb_menu.menu_depth AS depth, tb_menu.sort_order, CASE WHEN tb_menu.use_yn = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS enabled, CASE WHEN tb_menu.open_yn = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS visible, NULL::BIGINT AS created_by, NULL::BIGINT AS updated_by, tb_menu.frst_reg_dt AS created_at, tb_menu.lst_chg_dt AS updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_code ORDER BY p_code_no ASC, sort_order ASC, code_no ASC
SELECT FROM tb_code WHERE p_code_no = COALESCE(#{parentId}, 0) AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, code_no ASC

SELECT code_group.code_group AS "groupCode", code_value.code_group AS "codeKey", code_value.code_nm AS "name", code_value.code_val AS "value", code_value.sort_order AS "sortOrder" FROM tb_code code_group JOIN tb_code code_value ON code_value.p_code_no = code_group.code_no AND code_value.code_depth = 3 AND code_value.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE code_group.code_depth = 2 AND code_group.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY code_group.sort_order, code_group.code_no, code_value.sort_order, code_value.code_no

SELECT code.code_no AS "codeNo", code.code_nm AS "codeNm", COALESCE(code.code_val, '') AS "codeVal", COALESCE(code.code_group, '') AS "codeGroup", COALESCE(code.code_dc, '') AS "codeDc", code.code_depth AS "codeDepth", COALESCE(parent.code_no, 0) AS "parentCodeNo", COALESCE(parent.code_nm, '') AS "parentCodeNm", COALESCE(parent.code_group, '') AS "parentCodeGroup" FROM tb_code code LEFT JOIN tb_code parent ON parent.code_no = code.p_code_no WHERE code.code_no = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_code ( p_code_no, code_group, code_nm, code_val, code_dc, code_depth, sort_order, use_yn, frst_regr_empno, frst_reg_dt, lst_chgr_empno, lst_chg_dt ) VALUES ( COALESCE(#{parentId}, 0), #{code}, #{name}, #{value}, #{description}, #{depth}, #{sortOrder}, CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{updatedBy}, now(), #{updatedBy}, now() )

INSERT INTO tb_code ( p_code_no, code_group, code_nm, code_depth, sort_order, use_yn, frst_regr_empno, frst_reg_dt, lst_chgr_empno, lst_chg_dt ) VALUES ( COALESCE(#{parentId}, 0), NULL, #{name}, #{depth}, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sort_order) + 1 FROM tb_code WHERE p_code_no = COALESCE(#{parentId}, 0)), 1), 'Y', #{updatedBy}, now(), #{updatedBy}, now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_code SET p_code_no = COALESCE(#{parentId}, 0), code_group = #{code}, code_nm = #{name}, code_val = #{value}, code_dc = #{description}, code_depth = #{depth}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, lst_chgr_empno = #{updatedBy}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE code_no = #{id}
UPDATE tb_code SET code_nm = #{name}, code_val = #{value}, code_group = #{codeGroup}, code_dc = #{description}, lst_chgr_empno = #{updatedBy}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE code_no = #{id}
UPDATE tb_code SET code_nm = #{name}, lst_chgr_empno = #{updatedBy}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE code_no = #{id}
UPDATE tb_code SET sort_order = #{sortOrder}, lst_chgr_empno = #{updatedBy}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE code_no = #{id}

WITH RECURSIVE sub_codes AS ( SELECT code_no FROM tb_code WHERE code_no = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT child.code_no FROM tb_code child JOIN sub_codes parent ON child.p_code_no = parent.code_no ) UPDATE tb_code SET use_yn = 'N', lst_chgr_empno = #{updatedBy}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE code_no IN (SELECT code_no FROM sub_codes)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_menu ORDER BY p_menu_no ASC, sort_order ASC, menu_no ASC
SELECT FROM tb_menu WHERE p_menu_no = COALESCE(#{parentId}, 0) AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, menu_no ASC

SELECT menu_no AS "menuNo", menu_nm AS "menuNm", menu_depth AS "menuDepth", menu_url AS "menuUrl", open_yn AS "openYn", target_blank_yn AS "targetBlankYn", menu_type AS "menuType", menu_url AS "relUrl" FROM tb_menu WHERE menu_no = #{id}
SELECT FROM tb_menu WHERE menu_url = #{url} ORDER BY menu_no ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_menu ( p_menu_no, menu_nm, menu_type, menu_depth, sort_order, target_blank_yn, menu_url, open_yn, use_yn, frst_regr_empno, frst_reg_dt, lst_chgr_empno, lst_chg_dt ) VALUES ( COALESCE(#{parentId}, 0), #{title}, 'ADM', CASE WHEN #{parentId} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE((SELECT menu_depth + 1 FROM tb_menu WHERE menu_no = #{parentId}), 2) END, #{sortOrder}, 'N', #{url}, CASE WHEN #{visible} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{updatedBy}, now(), #{updatedBy}, now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_menu SET p_menu_no = COALESCE(#{parentId}, 0), menu_nm = #{title}, menu_type = 'ADM', menu_depth = CASE WHEN #{parentId} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE((SELECT parent.menu_depth + 1 FROM tb_menu parent WHERE parent.menu_no = #{parentId}), 2) END, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, target_blank_yn = 'N', menu_url = #{url}, open_yn = CASE WHEN #{visible} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, use_yn = CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, lst_chgr_empno = #{updatedBy}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE menu_no = #{id}

UPDATE tb_menu SET menu_nm = #{title}, open_yn = #{openYn}, target_blank_yn = #{targetBlankYn}, menu_type = #{menuType}, menu_url = #{url}, lst_chgr_empno = #{updatedBy}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE menu_no = #{id}
UPDATE tb_menu SET menu_nm = #{title}, lst_chgr_empno = #{updatedBy}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE menu_no = #{id}
UPDATE tb_menu SET sort_order = #{sortOrder}, lst_chgr_empno = #{updatedBy}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE menu_no = #{id}

WITH RECURSIVE sub_menus AS ( SELECT menu_no FROM tb_menu WHERE menu_no = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT child.menu_no FROM tb_menu child JOIN sub_menus parent ON child.p_menu_no = parent.menu_no ) UPDATE tb_menu SET use_yn = 'N', open_yn = 'N', lst_chgr_empno = #{updatedBy}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE menu_no IN (SELECT menu_no FROM sub_menus)
mapper.select: SELECT auth_no AS id, auth_nm AS code, auth_dc AS description FROM tb_auth WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND dept_cd IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order ASC, auth_no ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_auth ( auth_nm, auth_dc, sort_order, use_yn, frst_regr_empno, frst_reg_dt, lst_chgr_empno, lst_chg_dt ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{description}, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sort_order) + 1 FROM tb_auth WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND dept_cd IS NULL), 1), 'Y', #{updatedBy}, now(), #{updatedBy}, now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_auth SET use_yn = 'N', lst_chgr_empno = #{updatedBy}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE auth_no = #{authNo}
mapper.select: SELECT am.menu_no FROM tb_auth_menu_adm am JOIN tb_auth a ON a.auth_no = am.auth_no WHERE a.auth_nm = #{roleCode} AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND am.use_yn = 'Y' AND am.select_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY am.menu_no ASC

SELECT m.menu_no AS "menuNo", NULLIF(m.p_menu_no, 0) AS "pMenuNo", m.menu_nm AS "menuNm", m.menu_depth AS "menuDepth", COALESCE(am.select_yn, 'N') AS "selectYn", COALESCE(am.insert_yn, 'N') AS "insertYn", COALESCE(am.update_yn, 'N') AS "updateYn", COALESCE(am.delete_yn, 'N') AS "deleteYn", COALESCE(am.proc_yn, 'N') AS "procYn" FROM tb_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_auth_menu_adm am ON am.menu_no = m.menu_no AND am.auth_no = #{authNo} AND am.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.p_menu_no ASC, m.sort_order ASC, m.menu_no ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_auth_menu_adm WHERE auth_no = (SELECT auth_no FROM tb_auth WHERE auth_nm = #{roleCode} AND use_yn = 'Y')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_auth_menu_adm ( auth_no, menu_no, p_menu_no, select_yn, insert_yn, update_yn, delete_yn, proc_yn, use_yn, frst_regr_empno, frst_reg_dt, lst_chgr_empno, lst_chg_dt ) SELECT a.auth_no, m.menu_no, m.p_menu_no, 'Y', 'Y', 'Y', 'Y', 'Y', 'Y', 'system', now(), 'system', now() FROM tb_auth a JOIN tb_menu m ON m.menu_no = #{menuId} WHERE a.auth_nm = #{roleCode} AND a.use_yn = 'Y' ON CONFLICT (auth_no, menu_no) DO UPDATE SET select_yn = 'Y', insert_yn = 'Y', update_yn = 'Y', delete_yn = 'Y', proc_yn = 'Y', use_yn = 'Y', lst_chg_dt = now()

INSERT INTO tb_auth_menu_adm ( auth_no, menu_no, p_menu_no, select_yn, insert_yn, update_yn, delete_yn, proc_yn, use_yn, frst_regr_empno, frst_reg_dt, lst_chgr_empno, lst_chg_dt ) VALUES ( #{authNo}, #{menuNo}, COALESCE(#{pMenuNo}, 0), #{selectYn}, #{insertYn}, #{updateYn}, #{deleteYn}, #{procYn}, 'Y', 'system', now(), 'system', now() ) ON CONFLICT (auth_no, menu_no) DO UPDATE SET p_menu_no = EXCLUDED.p_menu_no, select_yn = EXCLUDED.select_yn, insert_yn = EXCLUDED.insert_yn, update_yn = EXCLUDED.update_yn, delete_yn = EXCLUDED.delete_yn, proc_yn = EXCLUDED.proc_yn, use_yn = 'Y', lst_chg_dt = now()
